title.narrative: Comprehensive Engagement on Digital Sequence Information (DSI)

description.narrative: At CBD COP15 in 2022 there was an agreement to establish a multilateral mechanism for benefit-sharing from the use of Digital Sequence Information (DSI), including a global Fund (Decision 15/9). The Fund and mechanism are established to mobilize resources from the users of DSI (private sector actors) to support the Global South in their efforts to implement the goals the CBD and Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. DSI is also incorporated in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) in the Marine Biodiversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ) negotiations. Further, issues related to DSI is part of two other international multilateral instruments: the Food and Agriculture Organization’s (FAO) International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ITPGRFA) and the evolving Pandemic Treaty of the World Health Organization (WHO). This Project supports the formal negotiations through informal dialogues, knowledge products and other activities that can add significant value in creating safe spaces for more open dialogue and creative problem solving, especially for the IPLCs and the Global South representatives. The project is global and include parties and stakeholders to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) including indigenous peoples and local communities.
